name: Neo Geo CD
description: SNK's 1994 CD-ROM version of the Neo Geo, created to bring arcade-identical games home on cheap discs instead of very expensive AES cartridges. It used the same core hardware as the arcade board, but its single-speed drive brought long load times.

specs.memory: 7 MB total (2 MB program, 4 MB sprite, 1 MB sound samples)
specs.graphics: SNK custom sprite hardware, 4,096 of 65,536 colours

curiosities: The Japan-only front-loading model was made in only about 25,000 units.
The Japan-only CDZ of 1995 added a double-speed drive to cut loading times.
Some games took 30 to 60 seconds to load.
Eight games were released only on the Neo Geo CD.
story: Neo Geo cartridges were very expensive, so in 1994 SNK released the Neo Geo CD, playing the same games from much cheaper CDs.
Its single-speed drive made for long loading screens, which a faster CDZ model only partly fixed, but its CD audio gave some games new soundtracks.
It kept SNK's fighters within reach of more homes until the end of the 1990s.
